contract_plain_english: Using the paper's convention that every unsubscripted norm is Frobenius, the selected claim says that for any dimensionally compatible matrices A and B, the Frobenius norm of the exact product AB is at most the product of their Frobenius norms, with exact constant 1 and no rounding, approximation, exceptional-value, or higher-order qualification. (PDF p. 3, printed p. 953; anchors: Frobenius-norm definition paragraph and first-property sentence)
